description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLeaveAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides an API endpoint for retrieving employee leave data, including filtering, sorting, and pagination functionalities. The class uses traits for authentication and leave request services, and it implements methods for handling HTTP GET requests to list employee leaves.
